units.source_text: 在城里狭窄的院落里，这棵枫树可算是大树了。

en.t: In the narrow courtyard in the city, this maple could be considered a large tree.

units.source_text: 树干比千重子的腰围还粗。

en.t: Its trunk was even thicker than Chieko's waist.

units.source_text: 当然，它那粗老的树皮、长满青苔的树干，怎能比得上千重子娇嫩的身躯……

en.t: Of course, its rough old bark and its moss-covered trunk could never compare with Chieko's delicate body...
